eyebrow: The flywheel -- and the death spiral
code:
VIRTUOUS: Emit rewards -> Attract LPs -> Deeper liquidity
          -> Lower slippage -> More fee revenue

MERCENARY: Emit rewards -> Farmers deposit for reward only
           -> Sell reward immediately -> Price falls
           -> APY falls -> Farmers leave for the next farm
caption: Mercenary capital has no loyalty -- it chases whichever yield is highest right now.
